# Pearlcon Business Services

> UK-based sourcing, procurement and consultancy partner for oil & gas, petrochemical and industrial plants worldwide.

## Company
Pearlcon Business Services Ltd is a global industrial procurement and supply company founded in 2009, serving oil & gas, petrochemical, mining, industrial, railway and manufacturing sectors with sourcing from a network of 5,000+ manufacturers worldwide.
